html:
G'oya

Har fakultet ichida arizalarni navbatga qo'yamiz: ROW_NUMBER masofa kamayishi bo'yicha, tenglikda id bo'yicha. Keyin navbatdagi o'rni shu fakultetning beds idan oshmaganlarni olamiz. Joy soni har fakultetda boshqa, shuning uchun filtrda o'zgarmas son emas, faculties jadvalidan ulangan ustun turadi.

Yechim

SELECT f.name AS faculty, r.name, r.distance_km
FROM (
  SELECT name, faculty_id, distance_km,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY faculty_id ORDER BY distance_km DESC, id) AS rn
  FROM applicants
) r
JOIN faculties f ON f.id = r.faculty_id
WHERE r.rn <= f.beds

Matematikada 2 joy: Malika (580 km) 1, Aziz va Jasur (420 km) dan arizani oldin topshirgan Aziz 2. Jasur 3-o'rinda va joy olmaydi. Filologiyada joy 0, rn <= 0 hech qachon rost emas.

Tuzoqlar

RANK ishlatish. Aziz va Jasur ikkalasi 2-o'rinni oladi va 2 joyga 3 talaba joylashadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT f.name AS faculty, r.name, r.distance_km
FROM (
  SELECT name, faculty_id, distance_km,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY faculty_id ORDER BY distance_km DESC) AS rn
  FROM applicants
) r
JOIN faculties f ON f.id = r.faculty_id
WHERE r.rn <= f.beds

Yotoqda ikki kishi yotmaydi, shuning uchun bu yerda faqat ROW_NUMBER va aniq tie-breaker. id DESC yozilsa, joy kech topshirgan Jasurga ketadi.

rn <= 2 kabi o'zgarmas son yozish ham xato: Tarixda 3 joy bor, Filologiyada esa umuman yo'q.
